Answer: B
Reason: The ultrasound images demonstrate a right-sided lung lesion composed of numerous small, uniform cystic spaces (microcysts) that appear echogenic and solid-like, which is characteristic of Congenital Cystic Adenomatoid Malformation (CCAM) Type II. The color Doppler image confirms the absence of a large systemic feeding vessel within the mass, helping to distinguish it from pulmonary sequestration.
